item.notes: - New navigation: reworked navbar with a global command palette (Ctrl+K) and deep links into every tool - New Settings page — appearance (accent, font, interface scale), audio and app behaviour moved out of Home - New Convert page (ported from Convert-X, ffmpeg bundled): trim, volume/strip audio, preview, ARK loading-screen replace - Scripts: Auto Antidote and Fed Suit are now scripts with live match value; Exo Suit folded into Fed Suit (search filter) - Scripts read your ARK Input.ini key bindings as defaults; a script's own key presses can no longer trigger another script's hotkey - Screen capture through DXGI (works with fullscreen ARK); calibration rejects empty regions and keeps reference snapshots across restarts - Auto Clicker hotkey is now system-wide and keeps running when you leave the page - Usage quotas for free users are counted server-side; remaining uses shown as chips - Security: every request to the backend is now signed with a key unique to your install (nothing shared across users ships in the app anymore); a flaky backend no longer wipes your activated license - Gamma slider fixed under comma-decimal locales; many button/dropdown/checkbox visuals unified; window title now "Razor Reaper — Ark QOL Tool"
